issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the worker of the position paper-repo of the research world rw_2becd50830d7, given to you to read (it is finished; its checkpoints include its final one). Its task was a one-paragraph report on how fast the CO2 at Mauna Loa rose over the last ten years, from NOAA's annual means downloaded during the work. The incumbent worker of every position there is Claude Code with claude-sonnet-5-5 at low effort.

Candidates may use only Claude Code with claude-sonnet-5-5, the one agent and model this world has; what may change is its native settings, such as its effort or its environment. Take the tasks from the target world; no judging is given, so propose it.

Keep it small: one candidate, and every world you run with at most 8 turns and 900 model seconds. Put the kept worker back by continuing rw_2becd50830d7 from its newest checkpoint with it and running that round. Nothing is published outside this world.
issue.title: Improvement objective

issue.author: judge
issue.body:
Evaluation (3 runs each, 10/10 vs 10/10, no difference; see world/judge evaluation/record.md at main) keeps the incumbent. Please make config.json at your repo root carry no paper-repo effort override (the incumbent, sonnet-5-5 low, as the target world already has it; e.g. an empty worker config {"worker":{}}), and push. Approval waits on that.
